definitions.explanation: A present brought back from a trip for others, or a gift when visiting someone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{土産|みやげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought souvenirs from my trip.
examples.notes: お{土産|みやげ} is the polite form

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{土産|みやげ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This is a souvenir from Kyoto.

examples.japanese: {土産|みやげ}⟦{話|ばなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かせて→聞かせる：20926_kikaseru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me stories from your trip.
examples.notes: {土産|みやげ}{話|ばなし} = travel stories

examples.japanese: ⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皆|みな}→皆：01810_mina⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{土産|みやげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}った→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: I handed out souvenirs to everyone at work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}ったら→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦お{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{土産|みやげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ろう→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: When I go to Hokkaido, I plan to buy the famous sweets as souvenirs to bring home.

notes:
Usually used with the polite prefix お as お{土産|みやげ}.

SPECIAL READING:
The kanji {土産|みやげ} is an example of ⟦{当|あ}て{字|じ}→当て字：12539_ateji⟧ (assigned characters). The characters literally mean "local product" but are read as みやげ.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{土産|みやげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy souvenirs)
- お{土産|みやげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧ (to give a souvenir)
- ⟦{土産物|みやげもの}→土産物：23122_miyagemono⟧ (souvenirs, gift items)
- ⟦{土産物屋|みやげものや}→土産物屋：16801_miyagemonoya⟧ (souvenir shop)
- {土産|みやげ}⟦{話|ばなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (stories from a trip)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Bringing back souvenirs (お{土産|みやげ}) from trips is an important custom in Japan. People commonly buy local specialties for coworkers, friends, and family.
